questions.stem: With which question does a holistic Enterprise Architecture framework begin?
questions.explanation: Every project, product and solution starts with the question WHY; without answering why a solution is required, management will not approve the initiative.

questions.stem: How many types of architecture are there in an organisation according to the Enterprise Architecture framework?
questions.explanation: There are four types: Business Architecture, Data Architecture, Application Architecture and Technical Architecture.

questions.stem: Which architecture focuses on business requirements and creating value for business users and customers?
questions.explanation: Business Architecture focuses on business requirements, covering business strategy, business models, processes and capabilities, and services and events.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities belongs to Data Architecture?
options: Implementing physical hardware, security and network
Creating data models, data definitions, data mapping documents and data flows
Defining business strategy and business models
Elaborating the functionalities of business systems and packages
questions.explanation: Data Architecture organises and manages data through data models, definitions, mapping documents, data flows and data structures.

questions.stem: Which roles are named as being involved in Business Architecture?
options: Business Analysts, Business Architects and Business Data Stewards
questions.explanation: Business Architecture involves Business Analysts, Business Architects and Business Data Stewards, among others.

questions.stem: What is the focus of Application Architecture?
options: Application requirements and creating value for application users
questions.explanation: Application Architecture focuses on application requirements, explaining the functionalities of business systems, databases and packages within the organisation.

questions.stem: Which architecture implements physical hardware, security, network, tools and technologies?
questions.explanation: Technical Architecture implements physical hardware, security, network, tools and technologies, and executes the Application Architecture.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the roles named under Technical Architecture?
options: All of these are named under Technical Architecture
questions.explanation: Technical Architecture names Infrastructure, Technical and Security Architects; Data Modelers belong to Data Architecture.

questions.stem: In the Enterprise Architecture framework, what does management ask after Go-Live timing and resource requirements are settled?
options: Whether the solution will be implemented on physical servers or on Cloud (private, public or hybrid)
Which programming language will be used
Who will write the user manual
Which colour scheme the dashboards will use
How many test cases are needed
questions.explanation: After WHY, Go-Live timing and internal/external resources, management asks whether the solution will run on physical servers or on Cloud, then how and what will be implemented.

questions.stem: How does Application Architecture relate to Business and Data Architectures?
options: It defines the business requirements that the other two follow
It works and implements data as per the business requirements defined by Business and Data Architectures
It replaces Data Architecture in cloud environments
It approves the budgets of the other two
questions.explanation: Application Architecture works and implements data according to the business requirements defined by the Business and Data Architectures.
